description: A customer's statement of account for a period: their invoices, credits and payments, the balance due and its aging. Without a customer, every customer with activity. It only reads: nothing is sent to the customer.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

customerId.description: The customer's id, from find_contacts; empty for every customer with activity.

period.description: A preset: this-month, last-month, this-quarter, last-quarter, this-fiscal-year, this-fiscal-year-to-date, last-fiscal-year. Or leave it empty and give from and to.

name: customer_statement
title: Customer statement of account
